description: Replacement of timber windows with double-glazed timber units, the repair of metal windows with new secondary glazing (Flat 1); Renewal of all flat and pitched roof coverings with insulation, including increase in parapet heights to accommodate new thermal layers; External works including cleaning and repairing of masonry, repainting of metalwork and railings, and overhaul of the rainwater drainage system; and internal works involving remedying damp, removing hazardous ceiling tiles, and fire-safety improvements to communal areas (including new fire-resistant paint and flooring).
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>All existing historic features such as any surviving chimneypieces, plasterwork, architraves, doors, and staircase balustrading shall remain undisturbed in their existing position and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site, unless specifically authorised otherwise on the drawings hereby approved.&nbsp; The development and works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>All new and replacement external rainwater and soil pipes shall be of traditional design, formed in cast iron and painted black.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>No cleaning of masonry, other than low pressure (20-100 psi) Doff surface cleaning is authorised by this consent without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; Before work begins, a test panel shall be undertaken in an inconspicuous position and the method shall be approved in writing with the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the existing building during building operation and site works.</p>

<p>Before work begins, proposals for the method and extent of repointing and brick repairs shall be approved in writing with the Local Planning Authority and be carried out accordingly. The required detail shall include 1 metre square sample panels showing the proposed joints, mortar mix, profile and finish.&nbsp; No other repointing of brickwork is authorised by this consent without prior approval of the details.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the submitted details, the following elements of the scheme shall not be installed, implemented or carried out unless in accordance with details which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><ul><li>Details of the proposed all new and replacement roof windows</li><li>Details of proposed bricks and slates including product details and photographs</li><li>The works shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the details so approved.</li></ul><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>
